assumptions: The starter wins every listed trainer battle and receives all EXP; no switching, traded bonus, Lucky Egg, or Exp. Share.
Only trainer battles on the reviewed route are included; skipped trainers are not inserted.
Requested mode omits random-wild EXP; control mode includes the two documented wild defeats. Captures and fleeing grant no EXP.
The mandatory Tower Marowak is a separate scripted defeat; Snorlax and the catching demonstration give no EXP.
Rare Candies follow their observed positions and reset EXP to the next threshold; observations never reset the model.
Observed foe order is recorded explicitly, including trainer replacements out of party order. Identical foes are equivalent for EXP.
Level observations are claims from the review notes; discrepancies require focused video review rather than adjusting EXP to fit.
Level checkpoints distinguish explicit level statements from levels carried forward from the notes (including unchanged maximum HP); continuity checks are not additional direct video readings.
